sam_marketing: Quick sync  we're locking the publish for the 'Inference Runtime Playbook' blog tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need PR embargo note, CEO quote, and final assets.
rachel_pr: Confirm embargo time (for press) and a tight one-liner we can use in outreach.
sam_marketing: Embargo until 9:00 AM PT. One-liner: 'Redwood releases a practical playbook to cut inference spend while keeping latency predictable.'
devon_engineering: Assets uploaded to /shared/launches/runtime-playbook. Method blurb for press: 'Benchmarks run across three model sizes and two GPU classes; metrics: p95/p99, throughput, and cost/token with caching enabled.'
rachel_pr: Draft CEO quote: "We want teams to ship fast without surprise inference costs." @kevin_ceo please review.
kevin_ceo: Slight edit: "We want teams to ship confidently without surprise inference costs." Approved.
support_lead: Support playbook ready, I'll post rotation and canned replies when embargo email goes out.
ams-cms-bot: Publish job scheduled: job_id=runtime-playbook-176500, scheduled_time=1765004920, embargo=true.
sam_marketing: Thanks all  I'll send the final 'ready' at 4:15 PM PT and Rachel will send embargo at 4:30. Reminder: do not comment publicly before go-live.
